lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「やっと来たか」
lines.english: “So you finally made it.”

lines.japanese: 「え……？　ああ、隼人君……」
lines.english: “Huh...? Oh. Hayato...”

lines.japanese: 「遅えんだよ」
lines.english: “You're late.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　いやいや、そんなこと言われたって、この前≪面談≫したばっかじゃん。こんなすぐ呼びだされるなんて想定外だもん。で、なに、今日はどんな話？」
lines.english: “What? Come on, we only had an *Interview* the other day. I never thought you’d call me back this soon. So? What are we talking about today?”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、大方は予感してるはずだぜ？　分かってるくせにすっとぼけんなって」
lines.english: “Hah. You've got a pretty good inkling already. Quit playing dumb when you know.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ、ここはすっとぼけるでしょ。こういうとき、俺なんつって良いのか分かんないし」
lines.english: “Of course I'm playing dumb. I don't know what I'm supposed to say at a time like this.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえさあ……むかし思いだしてみろよ。俺らで≪安定≫するまでは、どんだけのやつが生まれちゃ消え、生まれちゃ消えしてったと思ってんだ。んな、今更いちいち名残り惜しむようなことでもねーだろ」
lines.english: “Think back. How many guys do you think were born and vanished, born and vanished, before we reached *stability*? It's a little late to get sentimental over every last one.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、俺は君のそういう、ドライに割りきれちゃうところが嫌いだったなあ。最近はそうでもなかったんだけど」
lines.english: “Ha ha. I used to hate that about you—how you could be so cold and just move on. Though lately I haven’t minded it so much.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、ちょっと悟ったの。大事だよね、そういう強さも。世の中のアレもコレもに、一つ一つ感傷的になってたら持たないわ。うん、隼人君の生き方、お兄ちゃんそれはそれでアリだと思うわ」
lines.english: “I think I finally get it. You need that kind of strength, too. You'd never last if you got sentimental over every last thing in this world. So yes, Hayato—your big brother thinks there's something to be said for your way of living.”

lines.japanese: 「見んな。俺をぬくい目で見んな。つか、そーゆーこと言うならこっちも言っとくけどさ、俺もおまえ嫌いだったから。でもちょっとイイジャンって思うことも、まあ稀にはあった。あと俺、もうじき消えッから」
lines.english: “Don't look at me. Don't give me those warm, sappy eyes. And if you're gonna say all that, I'll say this: I hated you too. Though every once in a great while, I did think you weren't half bad. Oh, and I'm gonna disappear pretty soon.”

lines.japanese: 「っちゃー……」
「台無しだなあ。隼人君さあ、そういう大事なことはもっと溜めて言おうよ。ウルッと来るタイミング逃しちゃったじゃん」
lines.english: “You ruined it... Hayato, when you have something important to say, you're supposed to build up to it. I missed my cue to get misty-eyed.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、これが俺なりの優しさなんだよ。こんなん女に別れ切りだすのと同じで、勿体つけたところで意味ねンだよ。つうか、マジごめん。この後のことよろしく」
lines.english: “Shut up. This is my way of being kind. It's like breaking up with a girl—dragging it out doesn't help. And... seriously. Sorry. Take care of the rest.”

lines.japanese: 「うわっちゃー。だからもー、君の口からそんな言葉がいただけるなら、心の準備させといてよ……」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. If words like that were ever going to come out of your mouth, you could've at least given me time to brace myself...”

lines.japanese: 「しとけよ、前もって。約束の日が近付いてんだ、こうなンのはおまえだって薄々感付いてたろうが」
lines.english: “You should've braced yourself already. The *Promised Day* is close. You had to know, somewhere in the back of your mind, that this was coming.”

lines.japanese: 「ン……まあ、そうね、それはそうなんだけど」
lines.english: “Mm... Well, yes. I suppose I did.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　そうやって、けっきょく目の前の嫌なことシカトすんのが、おまえの悪いトコだっつんだよ」
lines.english: “Hah! And that's exactly what's wrong with you. You ignore ugly things even when they're right in front of you.”

lines.japanese: 「いたたた、返す言葉もない」
lines.english: “Ouch. I have no answer to that.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、だからよ、たかが知れてるかもしんねーけど、俺のチンケなクソ度胸、おまえにくれてやるよ」
lines.english: “So, yeah. Might not amount to much, but you can have what little fucking nerve I've got.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「俺消えるつったけど、いや、アレ正確じゃねンだ。そうじゃなくてぇ。なんつうか、キモい言い方しか出来ねえけど──」
lines.english: “I said I was gonna disappear, but... nah, that wasn't exactly right. It's more like—shit, there's no way to say this that doesn't sound creepy—”

lines.japanese: 「──俺、おまえン中で生きてくわ」
lines.english: “—I'm gonna keep living on inside you.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　えっ？　ああ……そういうアレ？　なの？」
lines.english: “What? Wait... Oh. Is that... what you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。まあホント言や、俺だってよっぽど弱ええヤツなんだよ。そのせいで、小鳩やら色んな連中に迷惑かけちゃったし」
lines.english: “Yeah. Truth is, I'm one hell of a weak bastard myself. That's why I ended up causing Kobato and a whole lot of other people trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「べつにケジメってわけじゃねえけど、どうせじいさんと約束した日も近いし、そんだったらウジウジ消えてくよりかは、前向きによ？　こう、あとに残るおまえらの力になりてーなって思って」
lines.english: “Not like I'm trying to square accounts. But the day I promised the old man is close anyway, and if that's how it is, I'd rather help you guys who'll still be here than fade away whining.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかどうも、奥にすっこんでたはずのヤベえのが≪コックピット≫狙ってるみてーだし。そいつに対抗するためにも、俺ら力を合わせるべきだと思うんだ。場合によっちゃタカシもな」
lines.english: “Besides, looks like something nasty that was supposed to stay buried in the back is gunning for the *Cockpit*. If we're gonna stand against it, I think we oughta pool our strength. Maybe Takashi too, if it comes to that.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……うん、それは分かるけど……でも、その役目は隼人君じゃなくたって、お、俺だって──」
lines.english: “No... I understand, but... it doesn't have to be you. I-I could do it—”

lines.japanese: 「はっ、無理すんなよ。おまえは何とかサンダーで上手くやってんだろ。ああホレ、もう鐘が鳴ってる。時間だ、時間。ハイ≪面談≫終わり。じゃあな」
lines.english: “Hah. Don’t push yourself. Things are going all right for you at Alex-whatever, aren’t they? Ah, hear that? Bell’s already ringing. Time’s up. *Interview* over. See ya.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、うそ……待ってよ、隼人君！」
lines.english: “What? No—wait, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　んーだよ、しつけえな。オメ、最期くらいシュパーッと格好よく逝かせろよ。分かるか、ハードボイルドだよ、ハードボイルド。ああホラもう、カラダ消えはじめちゃったじゃん俺──」
lines.english: “Huh? What now? Christ, you're persistent. Let me go out clean and cool for once. You get it? Hard-boiled. Hard-boiled. Aw, look—my body's already starting to disappear—”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君」
lines.english: “Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「だァら、なんだよ。言いたいことあんなら早く言えっつの。おら、消えてる消えてる。もう消えてるよ俺」
lines.english: “I said, what? If you've got something to say, spit it out. Look, I'm disappearing. I'm disappearing already. Practically gone here.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。またあとで」
lines.english: “Thank you. See you later.”
“Huh? Oh...”

lines.japanese: 「またな、チィ兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “See you, big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth.*”
